title: Persuasive Writing
description: A persuasive paragraph that makes its case in four sentences; type it with conviction and even rhythm.

exercises.instruction: Move from claim to example to reason; let each full stop reset your rhythm.
exercises.text: Everyone should learn to save drinking water. Clean water is a precious gift. When we close the tap and fix small leaks, we protect rivers and lakes for the future. Small actions create a big difference.
